meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: free (free tier). status values: active (free tier). cardRequired null means the official page does not state it; false means the official site states no credit card is required. planKind has the same meaning as group, with the value free-tier (free tier). planName is the vendor plan name. specText summarizes the free allowances in the official wording; durationText covers duration and permanence; cardNote covers card requirements; limitsText covers key limits; risks covers notes; flags are entry feature markers: public-only (some features in the comparison table are limited to public repositories), no-card-signup (sign-up needs no credit card), shared-runner-card (shared runners require card verification), user-limit (per-group user limit), unlimited-repos (no repository count limit).

offers.title: GitHub Free
offers.specText: Unlimited public/private repositories; Dependabot; 2,000 CI/CD minutes/month; 500 MB Packages storage; Issues & Projects; community support; Codespaces access ($0 spend limit)
offers.durationText: Free (the official pages read do not state permanent wording)
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Several features in the comparison table are limited to public repositories (repository rules, code owners, draft PRs, Pages/wikis, secret scanning, and others); Codespaces free hours go only to personal accounts, not to free organizations; pricing page example: 2-core machines 60 hours, 4-core machines 30 hours
risks: Several features in the comparison table are limited to public repositories and unavailable for private repositories
Codespaces free hours go only to personal accounts, not to free organizations
Card requirements are not stated on the official pages read — check the official page
offers.notes: Public repository Actions minutes and Packages are free; Team $4/user/month (3,000 minutes, 2 GB); Enterprise $21/user/month (50,000 minutes, 50 GB).

offers.title: GitLab Free
offers.specText: 5 users per top-level group; 400 compute minutes/month; 10 GiB adjustable storage; 5 GiB data transfer per month
offers.durationText: Free; the pricing page states "No credit card required"
offers.cardNote: Sign-up needs no credit card (pricing page wording: "No credit card required"); using shared runners requires card verification ($1 authorization check, no charge), while a bring-your-own runner or disabling shared runners needs no card.
offers.limitsText: 5 users per top-level group; 400 compute minutes/month; 10 GiB adjustable storage; 5 GiB data transfer per month
risks: Shared runners require card verification ($1 authorization check, no charge)
offers.notes: Premium $29/user/month (annual billing); Ultimate has no public price, and the pricing page writes "Contact us for custom pricing" (quote-based pricing).
